Subject: Mutual Action Plan + next steps for Acme Retail evaluation

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery to make sure we’re aligned and to help your procurement/eval team move forward: 

1) Goals & success criteria
- Reduce inference cost per 1k tokens for customer-facing recommendation flows by ~30%
- Maintain parity with current output quality (human-eval score >= 0.92)
- Achieve 99th percentile tail latency < 200ms for median request sizes

2) Proposed evaluation scope
- 2-week pilot on a subset of live traffic (can run in sandbox if preferred)
- Redwood will provide a dedicated testing pool + pre-built monitoring dashboard

3) Owners & timeline (please confirm)
- Acme PM / Decision maker: Samir Shah (confirm)
- Technical owner: Priya Desai (confirm)
- Redwood reviewer: Lauren Bishop (on-call for infra/config)
- Target pilot start: Apr 19 -> Pilot end: May 3 (confirm dates)

I’ve attached the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with a proposed checklist and milestone dates. Could you confirm owners and whether the dates above work, or share your preferred start window? If useful I can block time next week to walk the MAP through with your procurement/infra folks.

Attachment: acme-mutual-action-plan-v1.2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
